bear.orientation: Head +Y, face +Z, lying on back, lowest point Z=0.
bear.visual_only_features: Fur, embroidered eyes, smile, belly and paw patches are UV texture on the deforming mesh. Ears, four limbs, muzzle and nose are part of the connected physical volume.

suggested_material.name: effective stuffed plush continuum
suggested_material.note: Homogeneous calibrated approximation to stuffing plus textile skin, not individually resolved fibres.

bag.construction: Exactly two whole cloth panels share the left, bottom and right U-shaped seam. There is no bottom panel, side panel or gusset.

geometry.method: Alternating row/column arc-length fit of an initially opened two-panel surface; sqrt-sine separation prevents near-seam initial cloth overlap.

bag.default_grasp_note: Front handle uses its real x-minus patch; back uses x-plus. This offsets the two palms to avoid collision.
bag.initial_separation_note: Matched interior vertices exceed 1.5mm separation; this is a geometric screen, not a full IPC triangle-triangle collision clearance proof. Shared U-seam vertices are intentionally identical.
